author: CDC / C. Goldsmith, P. Feorino, E. L. Palmer, W. R. McManus
why: PHIL 11279: colourised SEM explicitly identifying green HIV-1 virions on a cultured human lymphocyte and its projections. Direct file is the lower-resolution preview; the page offers an 18.07 MB download.
note: CDC PHIL original TIFF (same image as lores candidate), converted to JPEG

source: NIH / NIGMS full-quality file; NIH Image Gallery on Flickr for caption and licence
author: Seth Pincus, Elizabeth Fischer and Austin Athman, NIAID/NIH
why: Caption identifies yellow HIV attacking a blue human T cell. Excellent contrasting colours and detailed cell texture. NIGMS supplies this same image as a 3.9 MB full-quality JPEG; pixel dimensions were not verified.

author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
why: PHIL 18142: colourised TEM showing a single HIV particle budding from an infected human immune cell. A focused alternative for the card. Direct file is the lower-resolution preview; the page offers a 10.78 MB download.
note: CDC PHIL original TIFF (same image as lores candidate), converted to JPEG

author: NIAID
why: Caption identifies a colourised SEM of yellow HIV particles on a blue-green human H9 T cell. Strong colour separation for a 9:10 crop. Source-linked original; pixel dimensions could not be verified.

author: NIH
why: All sizes | HIV virus | Flickr - Photo Sharing!
